title: 第一卷 第9章 未经世事李群书第一卷 第10章 噬他人之河济吾身之海
content_zh:
竹林后面的房屋比林罪想象中还要破一些。
灰扑扑的瓦片缺了不少，门歪歪斜斜地挂在门框上，风一吹就吱呀吱呀地响。
但再怎么破，至少也能住。
林罪正打算随便找一间钻进去，就被前面的争吵声吸引。
“这间是我先看上的！”
“你看上就是你的？老子先进的门！”
“你再说一遍？”
“说一百遍也是老子的！”
两个人堵在一间稍微好一点的屋子门口，脸红脖子粗地对着吼。
周围的人自动退开了几步，给两人留出一个打架的空间。
林罪扫了一眼那间屋子，确实比周围的强一点——屋顶的瓦片相对完整，门也是正的，门口还没长杂草。
随后他收回目光，继续往前走。
没必要看。
这种事今晚注定要发生无数次。
一千多号人抢几百间房，不打起来才不正常。
但是林罪有一个疑问，就是之前招收的那些老杂役弟子，都去哪儿了？
身后传来的动静越来越激烈。
林罪头也没回，越走越远。
直到四周空无一人，他才停下。
把包裹往地上一放，盘膝坐下，从怀里摸出坐忘石握在掌心。

入手微凉。
那股微凉的触感让他迅速安静下来。
他闭上眼睛，开始默念《长生经》初篇的口诀。
第一遍。
胸口的仙骨微微发热。
四肢百骸都跟着暖了起来。
第二遍。
林罪能感觉到体内的那块仙骨产生了一种奇妙的颤动。
这种感觉很奇妙。
不疼，不痒，是一种酥酥麻麻的状态。
他继续运转口诀，让那股暖流继续游走全身。
刚打算运行第三遍，一股强烈的饥饿感从胃里翻上来。
不是那种有点饿了的感觉。
而是那种几天几夜没吃饭的感觉。
林罪睁开眼睛。
看来刚开始的修炼消耗的不是什么天地灵气，而是实打实的身体能量。
肚子里没货，压榨的就是身体能量。
content_en:
The house behind the bamboo forest was more shabby than Lin Sin had imagined.
Many of the dusty tiles were missing, and the door hung crookedly on the door frame, creaking when the wind blew.
But no matter how broken it is, at least it can be lived in.
Lin Zui was just about to find a room and get into it when he was attracted by the quarrel in front of him.
"I liked this one first!"
"Is this the one you like? I'll go through the door first!"
"Say it again?"
"I've said it a hundred times and it's mine!"
Two people blocked the door of a slightly better room, shouting at each other with red faces and thick necks.
The people around him automatically took a few steps back, leaving a space for the two of them to fight.
Lin Zui glanced at that room and found that it was indeed better than the others around it - the roof tiles were relatively intact, the door was upright, and there were no weeds growing at the door.
Then he withdrew his gaze and continued walking forward.
No need to look.
This was bound to happen countless times tonight.
With more than a thousand people trying to grab hundreds of rooms, it would be abnormal not to start a fight.
But Lin Zui has a question, that is, where have all the old handyman disciples he recruited previously gone?
The noise coming from behind became more and more intense.
Lin Zui didn't even look back and walked further and further away.
He didn't stop until there was no one around.
He put the package on the ground, sat down cross-legged, took out the Zuowang Stone from his arms and held it in his palm.
Start slightly cold.
The slightly cool touch quickly calmed him down.
He closed his eyes and began to silently recite the formula from the first chapter of the Sutra of Immortality.
First time.
The immortal bone in his chest felt slightly warm.
All the limbs and bones were warmed up.
Second time.
Lin Zui could feel the fairy bone in his body vibrating strangely.
This feeling is amazing.
No pain, no itching, just a numbing state.
He continued to run the mantra, letting the warmth continue to circulate throughout his body.
Just as I was about to run it for the third time, I felt a strong sense of hunger rising from my stomach.
Not that feeling of being a little hungry.
It's the feeling of not eating for days and nights.
Lin Zui opened his eyes.
It seems that the initial practice did not consume the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, but actual physical energy.
There is no food in the stomach, and what is squeezed is the body's energy.
